name: Another Beach Story
source:
Sunny day bring four friends to the unihabited coast.
The beach is deserted and silent, there is only those who busy playing while stringing memories.
But what happened ? One of their friend drowned while engrossed in fishing.
Her friends trying to help but something happened.
